source.notes: ICSE Class IX school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2018-2019', 'Mathematics', 'Class : IX', 'Time : 2½ hrs.+15min.', 'Full Marks : 80'. examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed academic year 2018-2019. durationMinutes 165 = the printed 2½ hrs. + 15 min. The PDF is a booklet imposition of 4 landscape sheets, each with two printed pages side by side: PDF page 1 = printed pages 6 | 1, PDF page 2 = printed pages 2 | 5, PDF page 3 = printed page 3 twice, PDF page 4 = printed page 4 twice. The `page` field is the PDF page. The PDF has a partial text layer that is jumbled by the layout; text was taken from RapidOCR / pdftotext and corrected against the page images, with mathematical notation rebuilt from the images. Section A (40 marks, 'Attempt all questions') is Q.1-Q.4; Section B ('Answer any four questions') prints Q.5-Q.11, so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. Several parts print no mark bracket (Q.3(a), Q.5(ii), Q.6(b), Q.8(b), Q.9(a), Q.10(a)); they are recorded with marks 0 and flagged 'No marks printed'. Q.5(a) prints two brackets inside the part ([6] after the ogive instruction and [4] after (iv)); the entry keeps the part together with their sum. Figures in Q.4(c), Q.6(a) and Q.7(a) are hand-drawn on the original. Quadratic equations, recurring deposit and similar Class X items have no matching Class IX chapter and have chapter null. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
